mines.mine_notes: Nicaragua. FY2025 (ended Dec 31, 2025): 212,887 t milled @ 6.4 g/t Au (97% mill availability, 82% recovery); 35,898 oz Au produced (2024: 39,941 oz @ 7.2 g/t). Production primarily from Las Conchitas deposit. $12.3M FY2025 exploration at San Albino property (Jicaro concession etc.) aimed at defining new reserves/resources. Sailfish Royalty holds 2% NSR + gold/silver streams on San Albino. No S-K 1300 reserve figures disclosed in the FY2025 MD&A. Post-FY Mar 23, 2026: acquired 100% of Mt. Hamilton Project (Nevada) from Sailfish for $40M (two gold stream commitments).

Open pit heap leach gold mine, Arizona. Acquired 100% of Goldsource Ventures (GVC) Mar 27, 2025 ($6.1M net of cash acquired). Operations resumed Q3 2025 with new mine contractor (main Moss vein + stockwork). MRE (Moss Mine Technical Report, eff. Dec 18, 2025): 12.33 Mt @ 0.31 g/t Au, 1.46 g/t Ag (AuEq at Ag:Au ratio 194.6:1; pit-constrained @ $2,500/oz Au, $29.2/oz Ag; Au rec 75%, Ag rec 33%). Company anticipates advancing to a Mineral Reserve Estimate + updated project economics in 2Q 2026. Gold production resumed in Q4 2025 (table parsing partial). All operating permits in good standing.

notes: FY ended Dec 31, 2025; figures USD. FY2025 revenue US$148.5M (2024: US$92.1M); consolidated gold sold 41,686 oz (2024: 39,001 oz); avg realized gold price US$3,515/oz (2024: US$2,650/oz). Q4 2025: revenue $50.4M, 11,564 oz sold @ $4,313/oz, cash cost $1,572/oz, AISC $1,876/oz, net income $14.3M. Full-year ROE 29.6%, ROA 21.4%. FY2025 operating cash flow $53.0M. Oct 28, 2025 financing package: brokered PP $28.8M (C$40.3M) + Wexford PP $10.7M (C$15.0M); Wexford loan fully repaid ($6.5M). Eagle Mountain Project (Guyana): ESIA submitted Mar 25, 2026 (post-FY); PEA-supported. Growth pipeline also includes exploration land in Nicaragua. Tickers: TSX-V:MKO / NASDAQ:MAKO.
